'''Gisela Anton''' (born ''Gisela Glasmachers''; 27 March 1955 in [[Bullay]])<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Jugend |first=Stiftung |date=2015 |url=https://www.jugend-forscht.de/stiftung-jugend-forscht-e-v/historie/erfolgreiche-ehemalige/zwei-karrieren-eine-ehe-und-ein-wichtiger-preis.html |title=Zwei Karrieren, eine Ehe und ein wichtiger Preis | url-status=live |access-date=10 April 2022 |website=Jugend Forscht |language=de |archive-date=15 January 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220115152432/https://www.jugend-forscht.de/stiftung-jugend-forscht-e-v/historie/erfolgreiche-ehemalige/zwei-karrieren-eine-ehe-und-ein-wichtiger-preis.html }}</ref> is a German experimental [[Particle physics|particle]] and [[Astroparticle physics|astroparticle]] physicist. She was awarded the [[Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Prize]] in 1994.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Prize |url=https://www.dfg.de/en/funded_projects/prizewinners/leibniz_prize/index.html |access-date=10 April 2022 |website=www.dfg.de |language=en |archive-date=14 July 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190714010124/https://www.dfg.de/en/funded_projects/prizewinners/leibniz_prize/index.html |url-status=live }}</ref> Since 1995, she is a professor and Chair of Experimental Physics at the [[University of Erlangen–Nuremberg]].<ref name=":1" />

==Early life and education==
Anton began studying [[physics]] in at the [[University of Bonn]] in 1973. In 1975, she entered and won the ''[[Jugend forscht|Bundessieger Jugend forscht]]'' (National Youth Research Competition).<ref name="jugend-forscht.de">{{Cite web |date=1975 |title=Berechnung stabiler Schwimmlagen homogener Körper mit quadratischem Querschnitt mit Hilfe elementarer mathematischer Methoden |url=https://www.jugend-forscht.de/projektdatenbank/berechnung-stabiler-schwimmlagen-homogener-koerper-mit-quadratischem-querschnitt-mit-hilfe-elementarer-mathematischer-methoden.html |url-status=live |website=Jugend Forscht |language=de |access-date=14 March 2021 |archive-date=1 June 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150601111442/http://www.jugend-forscht.de/projektdatenbank/berechnung-stabiler-schwimmlagen-homogener-koerper-mit-quadratischem-querschnitt-mit-hilfe-elementarer-mathematischer-methoden.html }}</ref> After earning her Ph.D. in 1983,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Target Asymmetry Measurement of the Deuteron Photofission at a Photon Energy of 550-Mev and Proton Center-of-Mass Angle Between 25-Degrees and 135-Degrees |url=https://inspirehep.net/literature/189704 |access-date=14 March 2021 |website=iNSPIRE HEP |archive-date=13 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220413172036/https://inspirehep.net/literature/189704 |url-status=live }}</ref> she worked at the Physics Institute at the [[University of Bonn]] from 1984 to 1995, but also engaged in research work in Saclay (1990–1991) and Mainz (1991–1992). In 1993, she habilitated at the University of Bonn. Since 1995, she is Chair of Experimental Physics at the [[University of Erlangen–Nuremberg]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Gisela Anton › Department of Physics |url=https://www.physics.nat.fau.eu/person/gisela-anton/ |access-date=10 April 2022 |website=Friedrich-Alexander-Universität – Faculty of Sciences |date=5 November 2015 |language=en-US |archive-date=15 April 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210415043122/https://www.physics.nat.fau.eu/person/gisela-anton/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

==Career and research==
Anton's career has included working in the field of [[High energy physics|high-energy physics]] and the ELSA [[Particle Accelerator]] in Bonn and designing the ''Amadeus'' detector. For this work, she was awarded the [[Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Prize]] (1994) and the [[Bundesverdienstkreuz]] (''Federal Cross of Merit'') (1995). She studied [[baryon]] resonances by real photons.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Anton |first=Gisela |date=1990 |title=The study of baryon resonances by real photons |url=https://dx.doi.org/10.1016/0146-6410%2890%2990022-V |journal=Progress in Particle and Nuclear Physics |language=en |volume=24 |pages=303–321 |doi=10.1016/0146-6410(90)90022-V |bibcode=1990PrPNP..24..303A |issn=0146-6410 |access-date=13 April 2022 |archive-date=13 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220413172105/https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/014664109090022V?via%3Dihub |url-status=live |url-access=subscription }}</ref>

In 2005, Anton explored acoustic sensors for the [[ANTARES (telescope)|ANTARES]] neutrino telescope.<ref name="NAUMANN ANTON GRAF HÖSSL 2006 pp. 92–96">{{cite journal | last1=Naumann | first1=C. | last2=Anton | first2=G. | last3=Graf | first3=K. | last4=Hössl | first4=J. | last5=Kappes | first5=A. | last6=Karg | first6=T. | last7=Katz | first7=U. | last8=Lahmann | first8=R. | last9=Salomon | first9=K. | title=Development of Acoustic Sensors for the Antares Experiment | journal=International Journal of Modern Physics A | publisher=World Scientific Pub Co Pte Lt | volume=21 | issue=supp01 | year=2006 | issn=0217-751X | doi=10.1142/s0217751x06033428 | pages=92–96| arxiv=astro-ph/0511243 | bibcode=2006IJMPA..21S..92N | s2cid=17905830 }}</ref> Her research focuses on neutrino experiments such as [[ANTARES (telescope)|ANTARES]]/[[KM3NeT|KM3net]], [[IceCube Neutrino Observatory|IceCube]], and [[Enriched Xenon Observatory|EXO-200]]. She is also doing applied research in the medical field on the [[Medipix]] detectors.<ref>{{Cite web |title=ECAP Research Groups – Particle and Astroparticle Physics (Prof. Anton) – Research |url=https://ecap.nat.fau.de/index.php/institute/research-groups/particle-and-astroparticle-physics/research/ |access-date=10 April 2022 |website=ecap.nat.fau.de |archive-date=13 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220413172115/https://ecap.nat.fau.de/index.php/institute/research-groups/particle-and-astroparticle-physics/research/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

Anton is the founder of the Erlangen Center for Astroparticle Physics (ECAP).<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ecap.nat.uni-erlangen.de/members/anton/|title=Gisela Anton|access-date=17 May 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304081831/http://www.ecap.nat.uni-erlangen.de/members/anton/|archive-date=4 March 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=FAU CRIS |title=Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Prize – Prof. Dr. Gisela Anton |url=https://cris.fau.de/awards/136826573/ |access-date=July 7, 2026 |website=Current Research Information System |publisher=Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg}}</ref> She is also working with the ''ErlangerSchülerForschungsZentrum für Bayern'' (ESFZ), the Erlangen Student Research Center for Bavaria.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Team und Tutoren – ESFZ – Erlanger SchülerForschungsZentrum für Bayern|url=https://www.esfz.nat.uni-erlangen.de/esfzweb/team-und-tutoren/|access-date=14 March 2021|language=de-DE|archive-date=22 April 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210422161304/https://www.esfz.nat.uni-erlangen.de/esfzweb/team-und-tutoren/|url-status=live}}</ref>

In 2005, Anton delivered the [[Emmy Noether]] Lecture at the [[University of Erlangen–Nuremberg]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Emmy-Noether-Vorlesungen |url=https://www.gender-und-diversity.fau.de/gender/veranstaltungen/emmy-noether-vorlesungen/#collapse_15 |url-status=live |language=de |access-date=13 April 2022 |archive-date=14 February 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220214224525/https://www.gender-und-diversity.fau.de/gender/veranstaltungen/emmy-noether-vorlesungen/#collapse_15 }}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Gisela met her husband Frank Anton at the ''Bundessieger Jugend forscht'' (National Youth Research Competition) in 1975 and was later married in 1979.<ref name=":0" />
